title: Sebastian and the Prom
author: Mirabel Delacroix
blurb: Beatrix Oyelaran, the new kid at a school built over something old, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before the final audition.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
